purpose: OWNER-DIRECTED (Tyler, Phase 1.5B review, 2026-09-06): 'integrate the permanent board structure directly into the environment plate' and 'integrate the trough into the environment in context so its timber, mud contact, shadows, reflected light, water and edge treatment are painted together with the street'.
